caption.en: Visual tokens for a square image as the side grows, N = floor(H/p) * floor(W/p): patch 14 (blue), patch 16 (orange), patch 32 (green). Quadrupling is automatic: doubling the side or halving the patch gives 4x the tokens (patch 14 at 336 px gives 576).
caption.fr: Tokens visuels d'une image carrée quand le côté croît, N = floor(H/p) * floor(W/p) : patch 14 (bleu), patch 16 (orange), patch 32 (vert). Le facteur 4 est automatique : doubler le côté ou diviser le patch par deux donne 4x plus de tokens (patch 14 à 336 px donne 576).

caption.en: The MLP (LLaVA) connector with shapes: the same two-layer network is applied to every patch independently, so N patches become N LLM-sized tokens (about 21 M parameters for 1024 to 4096 to 4096).

caption.en: Cost ratio of keeping N = 576 visual tokens against compressing to N = 32, as a function of the text length T. Attention (blue) is ((T+576)/(T+32))^2, the feed-forward block (orange) is (T+576)/(T+32). At T = 0 they are 324 and 18; as the text grows the saving shrinks, which is why the claim '18x cheaper attention' is wrong.
caption.fr: Rapport de coût entre garder N = 576 tokens visuels et compresser à N = 32, selon la longueur de texte T. L'attention (bleu) vaut ((T+576)/(T+32))^2, le bloc feed-forward (orange) vaut (T+576)/(T+32). À T = 0 on a 324 et 18 ; quand le texte grandit le gain diminue, d'où l'erreur de l'affirmation « attention 18x moins chère ».

spec.title: cost(N = 576) / cost(N = 32) vs text tokens T
